selection_notes: Authoritative record of the generator selection. Eligibility uses the technical/scientific safety gates only (image count, exact-duplicate and train-memorization rates, corruption, metric completeness, test isolation, registry role); perceptual-hash rate and RAD-DINO coverage are descriptive ranking metrics. Within each family the preregistered RAD-DINO KID-primary hierarchy selects G02 (fine-tuned) and G07 (from-scratch).
